name: alice_rag_project
session_a_turns: Hi! My name is Alice and I'm a backend engineer.
I'm building a RAG system for my company's internal docs search.
For the vector store I'm currently using ChromaDB, and embeddings come from nomic-embed-text.
One thing about me: I really dislike verbose code, I prefer terse, readable functions.
We just decided as a team to ship the first version behind a feature flag rather than a full rollout.
Also, unrelated, what's a fun fact about octopuses?
Haha nice, okay back to work. My manager's name is Priya and she's been really supportive of this project.
We're targeting a demo for the RAG system in three weeks.
By the way I also mentioned I switched from ChromaDB to Qdrant for the vector store, it handles our scale better.
Cool, that's all the updates for now, thanks for listening.
One more thing: I prefer being addressed casually, not formally.
And just to be clear, we are NOT using ChromaDB anymore -- fully on Qdrant now.
